:::{#exm-power-set}
#### The power set of a two-element set
<!-- no-figure: a short list of four sets; nothing to plot -->

The [power set](#def-power-set) of $\set{0, 1}$ has four elements:

$$\powerset{\set{0, 1}} = \set{\emptyset, \set{0}, \set{1}, \set{0, 1}}$$

It contains the [empty set](#def-empty-set),
since the empty set is a [subset](#def-subset) of every [set](#def-set)
by @thm-empty-subset,
and it contains $\set{0, 1}$ itself,
by @thm-subset-reflexive.
Its elements are [sets](#def-set):
$\set{0} \in \powerset{\set{0, 1}}$,
but $0 \notin \powerset{\set{0, 1}}$.

:::
